description: Recommends the cheapest CookiePilot plan for the given monthly pageviews and number of domains, with current prices and limits of all plans, and a register link. monthly_pageviews is the traffic the user states for their site.

locale.description: Language of the user (two-letter code): sets the language of the confirmation e-mail, the confirmation page and the CookiePilot panel, and the currency of prices ("pl" = PLN, any other = EUR). One of: en, pl, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt, sv, cs, ro, el, hu, sk, bg, hr, sl, et, lv, lt; others fall back to "en". Defaults to "en".

monthly_pageviews.description: Monthly pageviews across all the user's sites, as stated by the user

name: recommend_plan
title: Recommend a CookiePilot plan
